snippet.title: Misguided Remastered - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to play as Silvia? 🪓
An ordinary high school girl who gets trapped in a terrifying otherworld. Search for her missing best friend and the last letter from her mother the only memory she has left.

Face kuntilanak ghosts and mythical Indonesian creatures with an axe & knife, solve puzzles, and choose your own ending!

Coming soon to Steam, Google Play Store, and iOS App Store!
DON'T MISS OUT! Available to wishlist on Steam today! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249080/Misguided_Remastered/
